name: dakotajune/seeders
description: Factories and seeders for Laravel Blueprint that are worth keeping: values from column names and types, real foreign keys, states, reference and demo seeders in dependency order, repeatable output, a preview command, and a guard on what it overwrites.

suggest.fakerphp/faker: What the generated factories run on, and what this package checks `fake:` methods against while it generates.
suggest.dakotajune/blueprint_models: Works alongside it; a contract test checks that factory values pass the rules it infers.
